Capture date: 2026-11-13 UTC (2026-11-12 Pacific). Native capture of the Account phone and street grid (plan Q1) and the overfull search cases (plan Q3, Org A parts). Q3 custom-rule cases 12 ran in Org D and are in the Org D facts.
Org: one fresh 30-day Developer Edition scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub, default Account, Contact and Lead rules active. Account.Ext__c (text, external ID, unique) and a permission set granting field access were deployed for the upsert cases. The Dev Hub active scratch record went from 1 to 0 after deletion and the local target no longer resolves.
Frozen predictions: Glade campaign/v039-duplicate-test-reliability 7b860d462 with GLADE_STANDARD_DUPLICATE_RULES=on, glade exec at API 67.0 with the same helper, before each native run: frozen/predicted-stage_q1.json (Q1), predicted-stage_q1b.json (gateOff2), predicted-stage_q3.json and predicted-stage_q3b.json (Q3). The scalar upsert case has no Glade prediction: Glade raised SObjectException (Account.Ext__c inaccessible in this context).
Design (Q1): every pair has its own Website host, its own ZIP and a distinct random consonant name on each side, so no pair reaches another pair's seed. Each method ends with an exact positive control (equal Name and City) and an unrelated negative control (same City, different names, no Website), asserted in Apex. Street relations S0 to S8 and phone relations P0 to P9 follow the plan. P1 uses dashes and P7 uses +1; P1b (dots), P1c (digits only) and P7x (x12 extension) are in the phoneFormats case at S0 and S6. gridZip is the 90-pair S x P factorial with ZIP equal and City blank (four methods). gridCity is the S0, S2, S6, S7 rows by P0, P2, P5, P8 columns with City equal and ZIP different. gateOff: the first attempt used a City that differed from the seed's City by one trailing letter, so City still matched fuzzily and all six pairs matched (native and Glade 100). That attempt is invalid as a gate test. gateOff2 uses unrelated Cities and different ZIPs; its prediction was frozen before its run. websiteVaried uses http versus https (W1a), www prefix (W1b) and a different host (W2). editAndUpsert runs update of a distinct Account into the match and scalar Database.upsert by a missing external key. Find and DML agree on every grid cell; the update case shows the edit is report-only.
Design (Q3): helper OverfullBehavior inserts 120 seeds in one list with allowSave, optionally updates seeds 0 to 19, then runs Datacloud.FindDuplicates (or findDuplicatesByIds after storing the candidate) and Database.insert(candidate,false). Recorded: size, first 25 labels in returned order with int confidence, compressed sorted member set, confidence histogram, rule name, for both Find and the save error. Labels are creation order. Cases: equal120, boundary99/100/101, strongLate/strongEarly/strongInterleaved, touched, twoPaths60/110_10/10_110, twoGates, nameOrder, byId, contact120, lead120. In the first strong* cases the weak seed name scored 100 like the exact name, so those three cases did not separate strength; strongLateWeak, strongEarlyWeak, strongInterleavedWeak, strongLate110 and weakOnly120 use a weak name that scores below 100 (93 native) and replace them. twoPaths seeds match through Name+City or through Website+ZIP+Phone; Contact and Lead seeds are identical exact records.
Committed case (13): driver committed-driver.py, anonymous only, API 62.0 and 67.0, two repeats, two variants (all-equal names; shuffled fuzzy names). Seeds were committed in three transactions of 40, searched in a fourth transaction that raised the frame assertion, then deleted in a fifth; the remaining seed count was verified 0 each time. The committed searches returned partial and different member sets from run to run (sizes 1 to 100). This is an indexing-lag observation: seeds committed seconds earlier are not all matchable yet. A settled rerun in Org D (groups committedSettled240: 240 s between the last seeding transaction and the search, API 62.0 and 67.0, one repeat, both variants) still returned partial or gapped sets (size 100 with set 40-end for 62.0 equal, 0-59 plus 80-119 for 67.0 equal, size 80 and size 0 for the shuffled variant). Committed-seed search results are not deterministic in this org and are not asserted.
Routes and repeats: APIs 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest (anonymous only for committed), each run twice. Helper and test classes were redeployed per API and ApexClass.ApiVersion was read back through Tooling API. The driver fails on Apex log truncation or exhaustion text, a missing or incomplete frame, or a class API mismatch. Where a method produced an anonymous exception the run stopped; none remained in the final data.
Result: all observations of each Q1 and Q3 case are identical across API, route and repeat. Committed rows are not.
